title: La investigación en filología hispánica
summary: This volume brings together a series of papers that explore the intersection between philological tradition and digital technologies, inviting readers to reflect on the methodological, technical and conceptual challenges posed by the digital transformation of philological work. The various contributions in this volume are structured around the use of the TEI (Text Encoding Initiative) standard as a common model for textual encoding, employed in the creation and tagging of digital corpora, whether designed for literary research or for the study of language. Drawing on projects developed in the Hispanic-speaking world, the chapters—which combine theoretical aspects with practical application—offer a critical review and highlight the potential of this standard as a common tool for editing, analysis, data retrieval and the preservation of documentary sources. The combination of theory and practice, together with the interdisciplinary approach it promotes, makes this volume a useful reference work that invites researchers to rethink philological practices in dialogue with digital technologies.
